paths.title: Angelic Avenger
paths.description: Take on the aspect of an angel, with astral wings, a blurred beatific face and a hovering flight that lifts you above the melee. Spending an action point sharpens your aim, while a chosen damage type of lightning, radiant or thunder scorches bloodied enemies who stay near you. You sweep a wave of astral energy over nearby foes, unsettle attackers with a fearsome presence, and answer being bloodied by leaving the enemy that did it exposed.

paths.title: Anointed Champion
paths.description: Sanctify your arms, armor and holy symbol with sacred oil and ancient rites, and pass the blessing to your companions. Anointed Regalia gives you a protective benefit tied to one item at a time, widening at 16th level to temporary hit points and sturdier saving throws. Action points add your Charisma to attack and damage, Blessed Blade shares your regalia with nearby allies, and Anointed Army blasts your enemies while granting lasting defenses.

paths.title: Astral Savant
paths.description: Draw on the Astral Sea itself to ward your friends and confound your enemies with cold or radiant power. Your healing word singes foes beside its target, an action point lets an ally spend a healing surge, and at 16th level a critical hit can return a spent Channel Divinity. You rush allies across the field through astral currents, flood a blast of enemies with a weakening wave, and raise an astral zone that either punishes foes or boosts healing.

paths.title: Battle Chaplain
paths.description: Lead by example with a shield on your arm and a hymn on your lips, uniting your allies behind a holy purpose. You mark enemies that your companions hit, and your action points let a nearby ally land a free melee basic attack alongside yours. Deeds not Words rewards each bloodied foe, fallen enemy or critical hit with extra allied damage, while your battle hymn and daily strike answer allies in danger of falling.

paths.title: Chromatic Bane
paths.description: Dedicate yourself to hunting evil dragons, learning to withstand draconic fury while keeping your allies on their feet. Each turn you can steady an ally against charm or fear, and an action point lends you resistance against a chosen element. Your signature Channel Divinity, platinum mantle, answers incoming close and area attacks by bolstering everyone near you, while counterstrikes and pursuing blows pull foes into a fight on your terms.

paths.title: Divine Oracle
paths.description: Speak with the voice of your god, reading omens that leave you and your allies rarely surprised. You roll initiative twice, and an action point earns an extra move action for later in the fight. Your prophecy of doom can turn an ally's hit into a critical, good omens grant a sweeping bonus to d20 rolls at the cost of critical hits, and Hammer of Fate lets a missed daily slide into another action. At 16th level your attacks against Will become far more reliable.

paths.title: Exorcist of the Silver Flame
paths.description: Become a living vessel of silver fire and a nightmare for demons, devils, undead and shapechangers. Your fire powers wrap you and a nearby ally in temporary hit points, action points add fiery radiant damage to your attacks, and at 16th level you reroll low damage dice against the Flame's enemies. Flame of Censure blinds a group, Warding Flame turns a zone to your advantage, and Silver Brand sears and dazes a single foe.

paths.title: Gatekeeper of the Golden Palace
paths.description: You are a shield and a spark for the people beside you, caring more that the party prevails than who lands the last blow. Fiery blessings flow through adjacent allies, you can pass along action points, and standing shoulder to shoulder grants better saving throws. Justice follows quickly: your daily power can stun a target while your companions shove or slow it, and every turn you end together helps the whole line shake off afflictions.

paths.title: Hammer of Moradin
paths.requirements: Proficiency with warhammer or throwing hammer; must worship Moradin
paths.description: Strike for the Soul Forger with a hammer in hand, whether you serve as a cleric or a paladin. You hit more reliably with hammers, and an action point attack can knock foes prone or leave them dazed. Hurl your hammer to bash two enemies and have it return to your hand, brace yourself in a stance of stone-hard resistance, and slam a thunderous quake into the ground. Your champion's aura steels you and nearby allies against fear.

paths.title: Heartwarder
paths.description: Fight like a gallant knight and a protector of love, using charm and compassion in place of brute force. Your healing surges restore allies beside you, and an action point makes foes take damage from their vulnerabilities. At 16th level an enemy that attacks you suffers a lasting penalty against you. Siren Voice dominates a target, Sune's Shield lets allies share each other's wounds, and Sune's Kiss pushes a foe away and returns harm to it.

paths.title: Holy Emissary
paths.description: Walk as a herald of the gods, with a divine presence that steadies your companions in the fight. Allies beside you gain better saving throws, and an action point lends them defenses scaled to your Charisma. Your healing grows richer against bloodied allies, and you speak Supernal. Trumpet of Awe leaves enemies exposed while allies shake off effects, Call Home the Weary pulls a wounded friend to safety, and your daily message of war lets allies strike a stricken enemy.

paths.title: Idol of Darkness
paths.description: Embrace the dark side of divine magic and become a figure of dread whose very presence breaks lesser wills. Your body shrugs off necrotic and poison harm, and spending an action point wraps you in concealment while your blows hit harder. Weaken a crowd of foes with Font of Despair, push away anyone who lingers in your unholy aura, and leave a tormenting curse behind with your daily strike. Every enemy that falls lets you slip across the battlefield.

paths.title: Lightning Blitzer
paths.description: Charge into battle in heavy armor without giving up your speed, striking with the power of the storm. Armor no longer slows you, and an action point lets you shift before or after an attack. Prophecy of Reprisal dazes a foe with lightning, you can punish an enemy that hits you with an opportunity attack, and your daily charge leaves a target blinded and deafened. At 16th level thunder crashes into the enemies around your target.

paths.title: Luckbringer of Tymora
paths.description: Trust in fortune and let bold gambles pay off for you and your companions. A luck blade lets you swing a heavy blade as a cleric implement, you can burn an action point to give a missed ally a better second try, and at 16th level you can roll a d20 twice once per encounter. Divine Tilt makes allies sturdy and enemies fragile, Luckbolt shakes off lingering effects, and Inauspicious Vulnerability exposes enemies to a host of elements.

paths.title: Messenger of Peace
paths.description: Seek to end battles with words, becoming the calm at the heart of a fight. You gain bonuses when your attacks do not deal damage, your action points make those effects hit harder, and avoiding violence keeps your defenses higher. At 16th level an aura of peace blunts enemy attacks nearby. Pacify can lock a foe down for a turn, a pronouncement extends one effect, and End to Strife can stop enemies from attacking at all.

paths.title: Miracle Worker
paths.description: Make healing your calling and let life energy flow to everyone who stands close to you. When you use an action point on a divine healing power, adjacent allies recover hit points as well, and your healing word dice grow larger. At 16th level allies near you gain extra hit points from second wind. You can punish an enemy that hurts your friends while healing them, rescue a falling ally, and transfer lingering afflictions to a foe.

paths.title: Paragon of Victory
paths.description: Step to the front as a champion of the gods, fighting with the confidence that you and your allies are meant to win. Action points become sweeping blessings of saving throws or damage, and every foe you drop can push enemies back or fortify a friend with temporary hit points. You can attack twice in a turn with fanatic zeal, rally allies with healing and a lasting bonus, and strike back when an enemy bloodies one of them.

paths.title: Seldarine Dedicate
paths.requirements: Elf or eladrin; proficiency with longbow or shortbow
paths.description: Raise your bow as readily as your holy symbol, drawing on the combined wisdom of Arvandor. A longbow or shortbow becomes your implement, an action point grants you an extra healing word, and at 16th level you can shift as you cast. Moonbeam leaves a target exposed to ranged attacks with chilling light, Shroud of Stars hides you in concealment whenever you move, and Seldarine Wrath lets loose a flaming bolt that burns and dazes.

paths.title: Soulforged
paths.requirements: Must worship Moradin; Moradin's Resolve Channel Divinity power
paths.description: You are tempered in the white flames of Moradin's forge and carry its fire into every strike. Spending an action point restores a spent Channel Divinity use or an encounter attack, and your weapon can blaze with fire and radiant light at will. A burning blast scorches nearby foes, an interrupt hardens you against danger, and your daily attack makes the ground around you hard to cross while your hits keep burning with extra Wisdom damage.

paths.title: Stone Keeper
paths.description: Carry your people's memory as a weapon, turning ancient grudges into holy fury. Action points leave your weapon strikes biting deeper, and a critical hit against a larger creature knocks it to the ground. You hit harder the more bloodied allies you see, swell your reach and speed until you tower over your enemies, and finish with a savage daily strike that heals your companions. At 16th level your divine fortune grows stronger and can return when you miss.

paths.title: Tactical Warpriest
paths.description: Wage your god's war from the front lines in heavy armor, turning battle prayers into punishing damage and shouted inspiration. Action points sharpen your standard action attacks, a rerolled miss keeps you and your neighbors fighting, and your challenge marks one enemy with the threat of an opportunity attack. Battle Cry heals bloodied allies as you strike, a critical hit can renew your prayers, and your daily fire sets whole groups of enemies ablaze.

paths.title: Truthseeker
paths.description: Carry the radiance of truth into the dark corners where deception hides, stripping foes of their tricks. Action points lower the defenses of enemies near you, your healing word protects allies against fear, illusion and polymorph, and at 16th level your Insight checks are all but infallible. Corruption Unveiled silences a foe's deceptive powers, Shrine of Clarity pins enemies against teleportation, and Moment of Truth leaves a target helpless.
